phase_name: Implement the D5 Artifact-Loss Check and --allow-artifact-removal Flag

objectives.description: Add --allow-artifact-removal flag parsing (repeatable, project[:type] form, hard error on malformed value)
Implement D5 check inside --deep D4 git block, reusing prior_json
Compute per-type removed/added path sets with untyped sentinel and archival skip
Emit log_fail with actionable message for violating pairs
Suppress via --allow-artifact-removal with explicit informational line
Emit log_pass when zero unsuppressed violations
Update header comment block (--deep checks list, Usage flag doc)

objectives.note: Range moved from 2,57p to 2,74p; verified --help output matches header exactly with no truncation or leakage.

scope_hypothesis_result: grep -rln 'validate-state.sh' agent-system/extensions/ found 4 hits: manifest.json (deploy-file declaration only, not an invocation), verify-deploy.sh (gate 10, invokes deployed copy with --deep <path>, unaffected by new flag), test-validate-state.sh (invokes it, Phase 3 work), and validate-state.sh itself (self-reference in header comments). The two-consumer claim (verify-deploy.sh, test-validate-state.sh) holds for actual invocations; manifest.json is a declaration, not a call site.
